audit.why: TRICKY / 6/10 fits 43.87% over 212 games with Kench owning 1-3 and two Skill rows. Chart matches the packet.
audit.corrected: Left at TRICKY, 6/10; the quoted 48% corrected to 43.9%.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 5-6 spike is written as if Highlander solves Tahm Kench's lockdown.
audit.why: Highlander grants immunity to slowing effects only. It blanks Tongue Lash's slow, but the three-stack STUN and Abyssal Dive's knockup both still land — so the spike is real but conditional on keeping stacks off you.
audit.corrected: Level 5-6 rewritten with the slow-immunity/stun distinction stated explicitly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Devour and Abyssal Dive are swapped throughout the content layer (spikes[1], spikes[3], mid, late, wants.foe[2], wants.you[1]), and the sustain is credited to a 'gray-health passive'.
audit.why: Riot's slots: P An Acquired Taste (bonus damage from health, and the three stacks that arm the Q stun), Q Tongue Lash (900 range, 5-7s, slows and heals him, stuns only at three stacks), W Abyssal Dive (17-21s knockup), E Thick Skin (stores damage taken, heals out of combat, active converts it to a shield), R Devour. The grey health is Thick Skin (E), not the passive. Also missing: Tongue Lash cancels Meditate, and Grievous Wounds is what beats Tongue Lash plus Thick Skin sustain.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected, Thick Skin named as the sustain, Meditate cancel and anti-heal written in.

edits.before: Tahm's Q slow-stun and gray-health passive crush your level 1 trades.
edits.after: Tahm's Tongue Lash (Q) and Thick Skin (E) crush your level 1 trades.

edits.before: Tahm Kench owns levels 1-3: his Tongue Lash (Q) slows and stuns you at three passive stacks, and his passive gray-health shielding means your early trades barely stick. Don't chase autos into his Q range; each stun proc lets him whittle you down safely.
edits.after: Tahm Kench owns levels 1-3: Tongue Lash (Q) is a 900-range slow on 7s that only stuns once An Acquired Taste is already at three stacks, and Thick Skin (E) banks your chip into a shield. Never Meditate inside Q range - the tongue cancels the channel.

edits.before: By level 5 your Highlander (R) speed and first attack-speed power let you out-DPS Tahm's tanky sustain if you avoid the Q stun, but at 6 his Abyssal Dive (R) and Devour (W) self-peel keep him slippery. Force the fight when his Q and W are down.
edits.after: By level 5 Highlander (R) makes you immune to the Tongue Lash slow - though not to the three-stack stun - and your attack speed out-DPSes his sustain. At 6 Devour (R) and Abyssal Dive (W) keep him slippery, so force the fight with his Q and W down.

edits.before: Late you out-duel and out-split Tahm one-on-one with shred and Highlander resets; his real value is Devour (W) saving allies in teamfights, so pick him or his carries alone rather than diving the group.
edits.after: Late you out-duel and out-split Tahm one-on-one with shred and Highlander resets; his real value is Devour (R) shielding an ally mid-fight, so pick him or his carries alone rather than diving the group.

edits.before: Tahm Kench controls levels 1-3: Tongue Lash (Q) slows you and stuns at three passive stacks, and his gray-health passive shrugs off your early autos so trades don't stick. Farm at range, dodge the Q, and never chase into stun territory.
edits.after: Tahm Kench controls levels 1-3: Tongue Lash (Q) slows you and heals him, and stuns only at three An Acquired Taste stacks, while Thick Skin (E) banks your autos into a shield. Farm at range and bring Grievous Wounds for the sustain.

edits.before: From level 5 the lane turns to you as Highlander (R) speed and your first attack-speed spike let you out-DPS his tank sustain, provided you space around the three-stack Q; punish him when his Q and Devour (W) are on cooldown.
edits.after: From level 5 the lane turns to you: Highlander (R) ignores the Tongue Lash slow but not its three-stack stun, so keep the stacks off you and punish while his Q, on 5-7s, and Abyssal Dive (W) are both down.

edits.before: First item is a skill window where clean spacing wins you the duel but a landed Q stun can flip it, and at 2+ items you out-duel and out-split him solo, so target him away from his team where his ally-saving W matters less.
edits.after: First item is a skill window where clean spacing wins you the duel but a landed Q stun flips it, and at 2+ items you out-duel and out-split him solo, so take him away from his team where his ally-shielding Devour (R) matters less.

edits.before: Spike your DPS at 5-6 and duel when his W/R are down
edits.after: Spike your DPS at 5-6 and duel with his Q and W down

edits.before: Shrug off trades with passive gray-health shielding
edits.after: Shrug off trades with Thick Skin (E) stored damage

edits.before: Use Devour (W) and Abyssal Dive (R) to stay slippery
edits.after: Use Devour (R) and Abyssal Dive (W) to stay slippery

edits.before: Track his Q (Tongue Lash) cooldown above all — every aggressive step you take should be on a Q you just watched whiff or go on cooldown. Also note when his R is up, since a roam means he leaves lane and you can shove and follow or take plates.
edits.after: Track Tongue Lash (Q) above all — 7s at rank 1 down to 5s, so every step you take in should be on a tongue you just watched whiff. Track your own An Acquired Taste stacks too: at three, his next Q stuns instead of slowing. Abyssal Dive (W) is 17-21s and is both his engage and his escape.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetability dodges his Q tongue-stun in a fight; Wuju Style's true damage ignores the armor and tankiness he stacks; Meditate sustains through his early chip but loses to his percent-HP devour, and Highlander's slow immunity beats his gank-setup peel.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetability dodges his Q in a fight; Wuju Style's true damage ignores the armour he stacks; Tongue Lash cancels a Meditate channel outright, so never sustain inside its 900 range; and Highlander's slow immunity blanks the Q slow, but not the three-stack stun or the Abyssal Dive knockup.

edits.before: TRICKY (48%): his Q and grey-health sustain edge the early lane, but I claim level 6 and decisively out-scale him at 2+ on-hit items.
edits.after: TRICKY (43.9%): his Q and Thick Skin sustain edge the early lane, but I claim level 6 and decisively out-scale him at 2+ on-hit items.

notes: Devour is R and Abyssal Dive is W; the content layer had them swapped in six strings. The 'grey health' sustain is Thick Skin (E), not his passive — his passive is An Acquired Taste, which supplies the three stacks that arm the Q stun, and that distinction is what tells the player to keep stacks off rather than to fear every Q. Level chart matches the packet, no chart edits.
